{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Read the data
trial_df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/trial.csv')

# Identify rows with sentinel values in biomarker_baseline
sentinel_rows = trial_df['biomarker_baseline'] == -999

# Drop these rows from the dataset
df_cleaned = trial_df.drop(trial_df[sentinel_rows].index)

# Compute the average biomarker change (final - baseline) for each arm
df_cleaned['biomarker_change'] = df_cleaned['biomarker_final'] - df_cleaned['biomarker_baseline']

# Group by arm and compute mean change
df_change_by_arm = df_cleaned.groupby('arm')['biomarker_change'].mean().round(2)

# Compute the difference in mean change between treatment and control
difference = df_change_by_arm['treatment'] - df_change_by_arm['control']

print(f'Mean biomarker change by arm:\n{df_change_by_arm}')
print(f'Difference (treatment - control): {difference}')"}
